text:
jenna (People Ops): @channel Quick heads-up — launching a PTO Donation & Emergency Leave Top-Up pilot starting next month. This lets teammates donate unused PTO into a hardship pool that can be disbursed to colleagues facing qualifying emergencies. Details below.

sara (People Ops): TL;DR — donate PTO hours, those in need can apply for paid leave from the pool; admin by People Ops; pilot runs 90 days.

emily (Finance): Are there payroll/tax implications for donors or recipients?

jenna (People Ops): Good question. Donors: no cash exchanged, so normal PTO rules apply (no additional income). Recipients: approved disbursements are paid as company-paid leave; we coordinate with payroll and will include guidance in the FAQ. We'll post a short explainer with examples.

miguel (Eng): Is donation anonymous? Can managers see who donated to avoid pressure?

jenna (People Ops): Donations are anonymous to managers and recipients. People Ops will only see aggregate numbers and payroll will receive donor IDs for processing but won't share them externally. We built this to minimize pressure and gaming.

hr-bot: Reminder: Eligibility window opens 2026-06-15. Donate via HR Portal > Benefits > PTO Donation. Minimum donation = 4 hours, max = 40 hours per calendar year for pilot.

emily (Finance): Will donated hours carry over if not used in the pool?

jenna (People Ops): Donated hours are moved into the pool and do not return to donors. If unused by end of pilot we will either extend, distribute to a designated charity (consult legal), or convert into an additional company-paid hardship reserve — we'll share the decision in the follow-up.

miguel (Eng): What qualifies as a valid hardship? Parental emergency? Long-term illness? Travel disruption?

sara (People Ops): Qualifying events include sudden caregiver responsibilities, serious illness, natural disaster displacement, and other verified crises. Minor routine needs aren't eligible. People Ops will run a short intake and a 48–72 hour review window for urgent cases.

jenna (People Ops): Action items: 1) Read the FAQ: https://intranet.redwood.com/hr/pto-donation (link has timeline + form). 2) If you want to donate, submit the form by 2026-06-10 for the pilot kickoff. 3) If you might need support, bookmark the intake form and reach out to people-ops@redwood.com — we’ll prioritize urgent reviews.

miguel (Eng): Thanks — appreciate the option. :heart:

emily (Finance): Can we get a one-pager for managers to share with teams?

jenna (People Ops): Yep — I'll post a one-pager and a short manager script later today. Expect a follow-up thread with the documents. :sparkles:
